remarks: Looking for the perfect townhome-style condo in a great Norwalk location?? This is the one....Enjoy easy living in this turn-key 2BR/2BTH bi-level townhome with parking, a low condo fee and super convenient location. From the moment you walk through the door, you'll be greeted by the refreshed interior ready for your finishing touches. The open and airy layout creates a seamless flow between the kitchen and living space, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. You'll love the new vinyl plank flooring throughout the main level, offering both style and durability. Appreciate the convenience & comfort of central AC, in-unit laundry & additional deeded storage in the building. As an end unit, you'll enjoy the extra privacy and natural light. Upstairs, the primary suite is a sanctuary with vaulted ceilings, full bath and a spacious walk-in closet with built-ins, making organization a breeze. What truly sets this condo apart is its prime location. You're not just buying a home; you're gaining easy access to everything this vibrant community has to offer. Morning strolls to charming local cafes, quick trips to local restaurants, and effortless commutes to the train, beaches, or shops, you'll find it all just moments away. Don't miss your chance to experience the perfect blend of modern comfort and unparalleled convenience. Schedule a showing today and see why this gem wont last.
